hook: Five people at a barbecue. Four are eating dinner. You are becoming dinner. Why is it always me?
Your friend has bare ankles and no bites. You have repellent and a personal mosquito fan club. Why you?
You move your chair to escape the mosquitoes. They follow. What exactly are you carrying with you?
A mosquito ignores everyone at the party and lands on you. What did she notice that you missed?
Scientists offered mosquitoes a choice between used nylon sleeves. Their choices help explain why you keep getting bitten.
